issues.message: MDS.VALIDATE_INPUT -> valid. StyleName 'FSCRT_R33 Style' (15 chars) and StyleDescription are under 240 characters; Status ACTIVE is under 30 characters; LineTypeAllowed=ALL and no line type input supplied.

NOTE: the rule is written for the REST object (Purchase Basis = Quantity/Amount). The Fusion CSV package carries PURCHASE_BASES lines GOODS and SERVICES instead, so the Quantity/Amount value check had nothing to test.
MDS.APPLY_DEFAULTS -> no default applied: no Purchase Basis Quantity/Amount field and no Line Type input in the CSV package.
